nominal_witness: Exact clean geometry/program frozen before counterexamples and holdout
selection: All required local routes must qualify; no lucky holdout selection, substitutions or lowering gates
core_experience_gate: One small playable representative first; no interface adaptation until its action/world/spatial consequence is demonstrated
counter_policy: Compare same external destination/reward/via-world outcome and capability conditions; retain legitimate alternatives; missing mandatory control words alone does not refute a design
family_count: Versions, adapters and experience groups reported separately; 30 instances is not 30 independent mechanics
